## Load datafiles and packages

```{r warning=FALSE, message = FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotrix)
library(car)



# IMPORT DATA FILE OR SET WORKING DIRECTORY

# IMPORT DATA FILED CALLED : Master_Initial_Litter_C_N_Data_NERC_Submission_May4_2026

data<-Master_Initial_Litter_C_N_Data_NERC_Submission_May4_2026


str(data)
colnames(data)

data$f.Experiment<-factor(data$Experiment)
data$f.Treatment<-factor(data$Treatment)
```


## BIFoR FACE

```{r}
BIFOR.data<-subset(data,f.Experiment =="BIFOR" )

BIFOR.Initial_summary <- BIFOR.data %>% 
  group_by( f.Treatment) %>%   
  summarise(N_mean = mean(N_perc,na.rm=TRUE),  
            N_se = std.error(N_perc),
            C_mean = mean(C_perc,na.rm=TRUE),  
            C_se = std.error(C_perc),
            CN_mean = mean(C_N,na.rm=TRUE),  
            CN_se = std.error(C_N))
BIFOR.Initial_summary <-data.frame(BIFOR.Initial_summary)


N.perc.BIFOR<-aov(N_perc~	f.Treatment,data=BIFOR.data)
summary(N.perc.BIFOR)

C.perc.BIFOR<-aov(C_perc~	f.Treatment,data=BIFOR.data)
summary(C.perc.BIFOR)

CN.BIFOR<-aov( C_N ~	f.Treatment,data=BIFOR.data)
summary(CN.BIFOR)


```
